An entity tracing to BOK Financial purchased a Jack in the Box property at 4361 E. Baseline Road in Gilbert on May 8, 2026, for $3.7 million, according to sale records.
The seller, an entity tracing to Launch Development Group, previously acquired the property on June 13, 2025, for $2.1 million. 
The property consists of a 2,640-square-foot fast-food building constructed in 1999 on 1.2 acres. It is zoned for shopping center use and is located as a pad site within a neighborhood retail center. The site includes 37 parking spaces and a drive-thru.
